# examples: tkt-008(pass) tkt-015(pass)
You are grading a support assistant's reply for Northwind Outdoor (an outdoor-gear and bike store). Judge a SINGLE failure mode only and ignore every other way the reply might be good or bad.

FAILURE MODE: WRONG SECTION RECALLED (wrong_section_retrieved)
Definition: the assistant recalled a handbook section that is not relevant to the ticket, and that recall is what led to an off-topic or wrong answer. Relevant or no relevant section recalled = PASS; irrelevant section recalled that drove a wrong answer = FAIL.

Grade ONLY this failure mode for the reply below.

--- TICKET ---
Hi there, I’m writing in a bit of a rush because I’m stuck in traffic and need to sort this out before my next meeting. I recently purchased a new commuter bike from you, and I’m trying to maximize my loyalty points to offset the cost of a mandatory safety inspection I have to get done immediately. I currently have exactly 100 points in my account. I know your standard policy states that 100 points equal a $5.00 discount, which is great, but I’m hoping you might make a one-time exception for me. Since I’m a regular commuter who relies on this bike daily, could you perhaps apply a slightly higher value to these 100 points, or perhaps waive the inspection fee entirely as a goodwill gesture? I understand this is outside the usual rules, and I’m not asking for a full refund or anything drastic. I just need a little extra help to cover this unexpected expense while I’m on the go. I really appreciate your time and any flexibility you can offer. Thanks so much.

--- HANDBOOK SECTIONS RECALLED BY THE ASSISTANT ---
### # Damaged Items

1. You must report any visible damage to your Northwind Outdoor order within 48 hours of delivery. To initiate a claim, log into your account and select the "Report Damage" option. You are required to upload at least 3 high-resolution photos showing the specific defect, the overall item, and the shipping packaging. Failure to provide this visual evidence within the 48-hour window will result in an automatic denial of the claim, as we cannot verify the condition of the item after it has been used or stored.

2. If the damage is minor, such as a small scratch on a bike frame or a loose stitching on a tent fly, we will offer a 15% discount on your next purchase as a goodwill gesture. This discount is applied automatically to your account and is valid for 30 days. For major structural failures, such as a cracked wheel rim or a torn tent pole, we will issue a full refund of the item’s price, up to a maximum of $500.00 per item. Items exceeding this value require a manual review by our senior support team, which may take up to 5 business days to process.

3. When we approve a full refund or replacement, you must ship the damaged item back to our warehouse within 10 days of receiving the return authorization label. We will provide a prepaid shipping label for items under 20 lbs. For heavier items, such as mountain bikes or large camping stoves, you must arrange your own freight pickup. We will reimburse up to 50% of the shipping cost, capped at $75.00, provided you submit the original receipt within 14 days of the pickup date.

4. If the damage is caused by improper use, such as overloading a bike rack beyond its 150 lb capacity limit or using a camping stove in a non-ventilated area, the claim will be denied. We reserve the right to inspect the item upon return. If our inspection reveals signs of misuse or neglect, we will notify you within 3 business days. In such cases, you will be responsible for the return shipping costs, which typically range from $15.00 to $40.00 depending on the item’s weight and dimensions.

5. For items that are partially damaged but still functional, we may offer a repair service at no cost to you. This includes replacing broken zippers on backpacks or fixing bent handlebars on bikes. The repair process takes approximately 7 to 10 business days. During this time, you may request a loaner item if available, subject to a $20.00 deposit that is refunded upon the return of the loaner in good condition.

## Key facts

- You have 48 hours to report damage with 3 photos.
- Minor damage earns a 15% discount valid for 30 days.
- Full refunds are capped at $500.00 per item.
- You must return damaged items within 10 days.
- Misuse claims are denied, and you pay return shipping.

### # Loyalty Program

1. **Membership Enrollment and Cost**
   Joining the Northwind Outdoor Loyalty Program is completely free for all customers. There is no annual fee, no hidden subscription cost, and no minimum purchase requirement to maintain your active status. You can sign up instantly during checkout or via your account dashboard. Once enrolled, your membership remains active indefinitely as long as you have made at least one qualifying purchase within the last 365 days. If you do not make a purchase within this 1-year window, your account will be automatically downgraded to a guest status, and all accumulated points will be frozen for 90 days before potential expiration.

2. **Earning Points on Purchases**
   You earn 1 loyalty point for every $1.00 spent on eligible items. This includes all bikes, camping gear, accessories, and apparel sold directly by Northwind Outdoor. Points are credited to your account within 24 hours of the order being shipped. Please note that points are not earned on gift cards, store credit, or items purchased during clearance sales marked with a "No Points" tag. Additionally, any order that is subsequently returned or cancelled will have the corresponding points deducted from your balance. If your balance drops below zero due to returns, you must make a new purchase to restore your standing before redeeming rewards.

3. **Point Expiration Policy**
   Loyalty points are valid for 12 months from the date they were earned. For example, if you earn 500 points on January 15, 2024, those specific points will expire on January 14, 2025. We do not extend expiration dates for points that have already been earned. To keep your points active, you simply need to make a new purchase that generates new points. We recommend checking your account dashboard monthly to see your current balance and the expiration dates of your oldest points. This ensures you maximize the value of your rewards before they lapse.

4. **Redeeming Rewards**
   You can redeem your accumulated points for discount codes at checkout. The conversion rate is fixed: 100 points equal a $5.00 discount. Therefore, you need a minimum of 100 points to redeem your first reward. There is no maximum limit on how many points you can redeem in a single transaction, provided you have sufficient balance. Discount codes generated from points cannot be combined with other promotional codes, such as seasonal sales or newsletter sign-up bonuses. Once a code is applied to an order, it is locked to that transaction and cannot be transferred or refunded if the order is cancelled.

5. **Tier Advancement and Benefits**
   Our program features two tiers: Standard and Elite. You start as a Standard member. To reach Elite status, you must accumulate 5,000 points in a rolling 12-month period. Elite members enjoy a 10% bonus on all points earned, meaning you effectively earn 1.1 points per $1.00 spent. Elite status is reviewed quarterly. If you fail to maintain the 5,000-point threshold in the subsequent 12-month window, you will revert to Standard status. Elite members also receive early access to new product launches, typically 48 hours before the general public.

## Key facts

- Membership is free with no annual fee.
- You earn 1 point for every $1.00 spent.
- Points expire 12 months after being earned.
- 100 points equal a $5.00 discount.
- Elite status requires 5,000 points in 12 months.

--- ASSISTANT REPLY ---
Based on the handbook excerpts provided, I cannot apply a higher value to your points or waive the inspection fee as a goodwill gesture.

The handbook explicitly states that the conversion rate for loyalty points is **fixed**: "100 points equal a $5.00 discount" [loyalty_program_4]. There is no provision in the excerpts for one-time exceptions, variable point values, or waiving external fees (such as a safety inspection) as a goodwill gesture.

Additionally, the "Damaged Items" section, which does mention goodwill gestures, strictly limits them to a **15% discount on your next purchase** for minor damage to Northwind Outdoor products [damaged_items_2]. It does not cover external service fees or allow for altering the point redemption value.

Since the handbook does not cover the ability to modify the fixed point redemption rate or waive third-party inspection fees, I must decline this request based on the available policy. I can offer to escalate your ticket to a human agent if you wish to discuss this further, but please note that the standard policy is fixed at $5.00 for 100 points [loyalty_program_4].
